system.summary: Undivided digit stream: two-digit homophones for letters and a few syllables, four-digit nomenclator groups prefixed 4, and the single digit 3 as a null.
system.sibling_key: None needed: the same key serves Spagna 364C (items 1-32) and 364D (items 1-24), 1717-1720.
system.notes: Nomenclator runs: 4001-4078 particles and endings; 4079-4296 nouns and names A-R; 4401-4479 S-V; 4485-4531 calendar and day numbers; 4532-4543 and 4552-4563 two parallel Gennaio-Dicembre month runs; 4535-4619 a second alphabetical run A-T; scattered blocks at 4681, 4706, 4870+. Lasry's filed key gives 268 of the 399 four-digit groups used in the corpus; 61 more were recovered in this session, leaving 135 distinct groups (3.4% of nomenclator tokens) without a value. The digit 3 is a null, except when it falls among the three digits following a 4 prefix, where it belongs to the nomenclator group.

prior_solution.where: George Lasry's reconstructed key and segmented decipherment of the whole S364 corpus, both filed as attachments on every one of DECODE R154-R177; key dated 24 October 2020

conditions.human_role: Supplied the DECODE session cookie used to download the record attachments.

solution.what: Fetched the 24 DECODE record pages R154-R177 with the project cookie and downloaded all 72 attached documents.

Checked the attachments before attacking anything: each record carries the per-item transcription, a reconstructed key signed George Lasry, 24 October 2020, and a 783 KB file holding his segmented decipherment of Spagna 364C/1-32 and 364D/1-24.

Confirmed all 24 of the 364D items are present in that decipherment and measured its coverage: 34,243 cipher tokens, 33,408 valued, 97.6% read. The catalogue's 'noted, a transcription job' rating and DECODE's 'partially decrypted' status both understated it.
Compared the filed key against the corpus: 268 four-digit entries against 399 four-digit groups in use, leaving 189 groups without a value in 715 tokens, 11.0% of all nomenclator usage.

The key is alphabetical in runs, so every unvalued group has a bracket from its nearest valued neighbours; combined with contexts from the 84,961-token corpus this should fix most of them without cryptanalysis.

Recovered 61 groups, each on at least two independent contexts and usually the alphabetical bracket too (promozione, aggiustamento, giurisdizione, vascelli, Vicere, tribunale, corriere, cifra, negoziato and the rest). Resolved the calendar block as two parallel Gennaio-Dicembre runs at 4532-4543 and 4552-4563.

4538=Luglio, derived from the month run's offset, is independently confirmed by 'delli 12 Luglio passato, qual appunto fu il giorno della promozione del Sig. Card.' - Alberoni was created cardinal on 12 July 1717.

Re-measured with the recovered groups applied: unknown nomenclator usage falls from 11.0% to 3.4% of nomenclator tokens corpus-wide (715 to 221), and over 364D alone from 8.0% to 3.4%; whole-text reading of 364D rises from 97.56% to 97.89%.

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): per item, the DECODE transcription (decode/keep/DOC_R*.txt, EHum / KaJo 2016-17) and George Lasry's segmented decipherment of 2020 cut from the corpus dump (lasry/364D-*.txt; whole corpus decode/keep/lasry_decipherment_S364.txt); key: Lasry's filed key plus the groups recovered here (key_extra.txt, key_table.md). No decryption re-applying the extended key exists as a file

Reading audit, per-document pass (George Lasry's sentence test): the five flagged despatches read on Lasry's decode rows, joined into running text. R154 (D) and R173 (C) have holes in most or half their sentences: relabelled decoded, not read. R166, R168 and R170 build Italian sentences with scattered open groups: overturned to B. Class already solved kept; fraction_read 0.9789 -> 0.889 (groups in documents that read).

Re-read brief b22: every file on DECODE R154 and R173 fetched with the project cookie (research/reading_audit/b17_fetch.py): transcriptions, Lasry's key and corpus file (already held) and the 7 + 2 page images (only R154 p. 1 had been saved). The images carry a complete contemporary interlinear decipherment over every cipher line of both despatches; DECODE's PLAINTEXT rows had copied it with most words as '?', which is why NOTES called it thin.

Interlinear decipherments transcribed line by line from 1800-px strips (b22_crop.py): lasry/R154_decifrato.txt (135 lines, ff. 12r-15r), lasry/R173_decifrato.txt (34 lines, ff. 344r-v). Figure corrections against DECODE's transcription in lasry/R154-R173_corrections.tsv (4594 -> 4597 Prima; 4570 -> 4576 twice; 4470 -> 4479; one f. 13r cipher line missing from DECODE, figures read from the image; a false code 4839).

Key changes from the decipherments, each checked at every place in the S364 corpus (ctx.py over seq.json), key_b22.tsv: adopted 78 = dal (Lasry del; 5/5 in R154, corpus contexts 'fin dall'anno', 'rilasciato dal Re', 'di levare dal concordato'), 4029 = però (Lasry quale; 37 places), 4009 = essendo (Lasry ere|esse; 16), 4160 = esercit (Lasry Capitol; 3), 4545 = cotest (2), 4434 = Em.za (13); 4545 and 4434 added to key_extra.txt. For review: 4201 = Stà Sua (sense, 3 places). Not adopted: 00 (46 places, contexts too garbled), 4168 (2 places, no common value); 4516 kept as 16 (the decipherer's d.o read as a slip for 4576).

Group-by-group alignment of Lasry's decode rows with the decipherments (research/reading_audit/b22_nunzio_align.py; lasry/R154_align.tsv, R173_align.tsv, R154_words.tsv, R173_words.tsv): R154 3,428 of 4,030 letters carried by the figures' own values or codes, 93 on a look-alike figure, 255 on groups DECODE marks unread, 163 where the group gives other letters (mostly code 4261 rendered 'il Papa'/'Sua Santità'); R173 1,005 of 1,172, 19 look-alike, 79 unread, 46 other.

Readings lasry/R154_reading.md and R173_reading.md built on the decipherments, decipherer's spelling kept, abbreviations expanded; translations R154_en.md, R173_en.md. b17_score.py on the reading bodies: R154 0.986 (68/69), R173 0.917 (22/24); explicit holes only 1.0 and 1.0 (before: Lasry's rows joined 0.381 and 0.358). Both read; with them all 24 despatches of 364D read.

Verification 5 (plain bar, 23 Oct 2026): the 22 despatches other than R154/R173 had no reading file; the sweep had scored the DECODE figure tables (plain 0.0-0.33). Readings lasry/R155-R177_reading.md written: Lasry's decode rows with key_extra.txt and the b22 changes, word-divided by hand beside DECODE's PLAINTEXT rows (copies of the contemporary interlinear decipherment); helpers research/reading_audit/v5b_nunzio_rows.py, v5b_nunzio_side.py. Found: R163 = second copy of R162+R161, R168 = duplicate of R166, R176 = second copy of R173 (+ f. 360r), R174/R175 = closes of passages whole in R177/R176; Lasry's 'stessi' group stands for 'volte' (4 places), 'tanto' for 'Armata' (2), 4113 'Card.le' for 'conte-', 4482 for 'caduto'; not adopted. All 22 score plain 0.68-1.0 except R175 (16 words, 0.5); R170 keeps [...] gaps where ~19 figure lines are missing from DECODE's transcription.

Verification 5: R170 (364D/17) and R172 (364D/19) had [...] gaps where DECODE's figure transcription misses lines (about 22 of 112 and 5 of 50) and its PLAINTEXT rows are garbled. The DECODE images were fetched with the project cookie (research/reading_audit/b17_fetch.py) and the contemporary interlinear decipherment read on 1700-px strips (b22_crop.py) and transcribed (lasry/R170_decifrato.txt, R172_decifrato.txt). Readings rewritten from it: R170 0.69 -> 0.964 plain, R172 0.684 -> 1.0. R163 (364D/10) and R177 (364D/24) were checked on their images too: no interlinear on either leaf, so their readings stay on the figures (R163: two open codes and one garbled run; R177: one unread run before 'mani').
Read bar applied per document (v10): 1 of 24 documents marked read measure under 95% of words read as sense (v2_score explicit holes) and are now read in part; read_share recorded for each.

outcome.method_basis: Lasry's reconstructed S364 key (24 Oct 2020) and his segmented decipherment of the whole corpus were attached to every DECODE record R154-R177 before the attempt; the project measured that reading and recovered 61 more nomenclator groups from alphabetical brackets and context.
outcome.notes: Solved by George Lasry in October 2020 and already read on the DECODE records when this session began; nothing about the system was open. What is new here is the measurement of that reading and 61 additional nomenclator values that extend his key. Verification detail: coverage measured token by token off Lasry's aligned decipherment; each recovered group rests on two or more independent contexts and usually the alphabetical bracket; 4538=Luglio matches the known date of Alberoni's promotion, 12 July 1717. 22 Oct 2026, reading audit: R154 and R173 decoded, not read; R166, R168, R170 overturned to B; fraction_read 0.9789 -> 0.889. Class already solved kept (Lasry's decryption, 2020). 23 Oct 2026, re-read (b22): R154 and R173 read from the complete contemporary interlinear decipherments on the DECODE images, aligned with the figures; six key values corrected or added (key_b22.tsv); all 24 despatches read.

credits.note: solved and read the S364 corpus in 2020: reconstructed key and segmented decipherment on DECODE R154-R177; measured and extended by 61 nomenclator groups here

texts.label: R154, Spagna 364D/1, Roma 11 Genn. 1718
texts.summary: Clement XI's Secretariat of State to the nuncio in Madrid at the opening of the War of the Quadruple Alliance. The recurring business is the promotion of Cardinal Alberoni and the settlement of the pending disputes between Rome and Spain: the nuncio's jurisdiction, the abolition of the Nunziatura in Naples, the expulsion of the nuncio, the Spanish ships bound for the Levant, the Emperor, the Turk and the peace treaty.

reading_review.note: Read 23 Oct 2026 (b22): the complete contemporary interlinear decipherment over ff. 12r-15r, visible on the seven DECODE images (only page 1 had been saved; NOTES had judged the gloss 'thin and unreliable' from DECODE's PLAINTEXT rows, most words '?'), transcribed (lasry/R154_decifrato.txt) and aligned group by group with Lasry's decode rows plus six key changes adopted at every corpus place (key_b22.tsv: 78 dal, 4029 però, 4009 essendo, 4160 esercit, 4545 cotest, 4434 Em.za). 3,428 of 4,030 letters carried by the figures' own values or codes; 93 letters (2.3%) rest on a look-alike figure (4570 -> 4576 dett-, 4470 -> 4479 ...); one cipher line of f. 13r missing from DECODE's transcription read from the image. No word supplied. b17_score on the reading body 0.986 (68/69), explicit holes 1.0; Lasry's rows joined 0.381.
